QUOTE: "section present but unusable ──────► logged as rejected, falls through (excludes-only, unknown key, no existing roots, not a mapping)" and "nothing usable ──────────────────────────► whole_repo_scope(root)"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says a declared index_scope is preferred and that unusable, absent or invalid declarations all fall through to whole-repo indexing.
